detail.title: Globe 50 Dual-Mode Wireless Mouse - 3200 DPI, White
detail.overview: The Ant Globe 50 combines Bluetooth and 2.4GHz connectivity in a dual-mode wireless mouse rated up to 3200 DPI across 6 programmable buttons, giving it enough range for both office work and casual gaming. A rechargeable battery delivers up to 50 hours of use per charge, so it stays out of the drawer far longer than typical wireless mice. Its lightweight, slim-profile design fits comfortably in the palm for extended sessions on a laptop, PC, Mac, tablet or mobile device, while dual connectivity means fast switching between paired devices without re-pairing each time.
